description: Two equality comparisons against caller credential data, separated by what the compared value is. The positive compares the credential itself with source-written text and therefore admits the caller by a credential in every clone. The negative first calls Object.prototype.toString and compares its result with JavaScript's standardized [object String] type brand. Requiring both the producer and the brand shape keeps an actual password that happens to use the same bracketed text reportable.

expected.note: the near miss that keeps literal-looking passwords reportable: the credential itself is compared with source-written text
